metas.name: Fool Night
metas.description: In a dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of transforming into a Spirit Flower — a plant into which humans transform. Should he continue living as a person, or discard his pain and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

metas.name: Always on Call
metas.description: A devoted team of medical professionals navigate personal struggles, political pressure and a risky new hire at an overwhelmed emergency room in Oslo.

metas.name: Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping
metas.description: 1982. When the matriarch of a Dutch hotel empire is kidnapped for ransom, her family launches a desperate effort to free her.

metas.name: Blade Runner 2099
metas.description: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

metas.name: Dig
metas.description: Follow four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

metas.name: The Trials of Karen Read
metas.description: An accident, a deadly fight or an elaborate cover-up? This true-crime series digs into the murder trials of Karen Read that sparked viral conspiracies.

metas.name: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
metas.description: Oobah Butler sets his sights on the world’s biggest industries and most powerful institutions. To infiltrate the worlds of wine, wellness, royalty, and more, Oobah hatches elaborate and increasingly audacious schemes by gaming online reviews, assuming made-up personas, and launching fake companies with entirely bogus backstories.

metas.name: MELANIA the Series
metas.description: Experience Melania Trump's transition to First Lady as she navigates the White House and puts her mission into action.

metas.name: Gordon
metas.description: Aníbal Gordon rises from a small-time thief to a convicted murderer in Argentina during the '70s.

metas.name: Valentina and the 12 Signs
metas.description: Valentina is a young woman who, after being betrayed by her boyfriend—and blaming astrology for the end of their relationship—decides to take revenge in an unusual way: she sets out on a mission to hook up with a guy from every sign of the zodiac. Her plan is to document all these encounters and experiences in a videocast, but things get complicated when she falls for a guy who has "no sign."

metas.name: Vienna Game
metas.description: While Napoleon Bonaparte is exiled on Elba, kings and crown princes, ministers and spies, noblewomen and mistresses, adventurers, inventors, artists, and concubines gather in Vienna to celebrate and negotiate. Here, the fate of Europe is decided on the dance floor and in the boudoir.

metas.name: Win the Mall
metas.description: Ten teams move into a mall where they must conquer storefronts, forge alliances and outsmart rivals to win $1 million in this reality competition series.
Three intertwined timelines follow the planning and execution of a daring heist in Zurich and its aftermath as an FBI agent pursues a master criminal across Europe.

metas.name: Stars and Vows: Anele & Buzza
metas.description: Follow media darling Anele Mdoda and her royal fiance Buzza James from pre-wedding celebrations and tense family moments to their long-awaited "I do."

metas.name: Silent Night
metas.description:
Christmas Eve, 1976. Snow, silence, darkness. Three young people—a pregnant woman, her husband, and his younger brother—are killed by a bus while on their way to Midnight Mass.

metas.name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
metas.description: קבוצה של אימהות צעירות ודינמיות מאורנג' קאונטי מעוררת סערה בקהילה שבה האמונה היא הזהות עצמה. חלקן נלחמות לשמר את המסורת, אחרות מאמצות את המודרנה ויוצאות לזעזע את המוסכמות. סודות ייחשפו, חזותות יתנפצו וחברויות יועמדו למבחן כשקבוצת המשפיעניות פורצות הדרך הזאת מתאחדת כדי ליצור את התשובה שלהן ל-#MomTok.

metas.name: Miracles of the ER
metas.description: A bold decision brings an average med student to an elite ER team, where he encounters medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and personal growth.

metas.name: Alicia's Law
metas.description: When her carefully built life comes undone, Alicia returns to practicing law and discovers that rebuilding her career also means redefining herself.

metas.name: Get Huge: Looksmaxxing to Death
metas.description: An unflinching portrait of masculinity in the influencer age, where extreme biohacking, online performance and a series of suspicious deaths converge.

metas.name: Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook
metas.description: Hollywood actor and comedian Nora Lum (a.k.a. Awkwafina) is the descendant of restaurant royalty...but she can't cook. Join the star on an inspiring culinary road trip as she learns the craft and attempts to revive her family's beloved Chinese eatery.

metas.name: Demonzu Kuresto

metas.name: Melania Rea
metas.description: The tragic story of Melania Rea, whose case reveals a toxic marriage marked by lies and manipulation.

metas.name: Taken: Natalee Holloway
metas.description: Explores the 2005 disappearance of 18-year-old Natalee Holloway during a graduation trip to Aruba and her mother Beth's two-decade search for answers and justice.

metas.name: Akka
metas.description: In a kingdom ruled by women, matriarch Bhavani faces her biggest threat in Rudra, a ruthless rebel eyeing her land and legacy.

metas.name: Obsess
metas.description: After returning home, Talal is pulled into a dark psychological journey where the lines between guilt, desire and his own disturbing impulses begin to blur. As buried feelings connected to a past love resurface, the darkness inside him grows stronger. Talal is forced to confront a terrifying question: can he free himself from his past, or will it consume him completely?

metas.name: Balaraw: Blood Island
metas.description: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

metas.name: The Fall of El Mayo
metas.description: Co-founder of the Sinaloa Cartel, longtime partner of "El Chapo", and a ghost to authorities for over three decades. The documentary that tells the story of his downfall.

metas.name: The Gift of Deceit
metas.description: Desperate to find a cure for the unknown illness affecting her daughter, art collector Lúcia Rossetti turns to a spiritual healer. When Lúcia falls victim to a scam, a series of secrets is revealed, intertwining two families marked by love, control, resentment, and guilt.

metas.name: The One About Matthew Perry
metas.description: Through personal accounts from family and friends, this documentary unveils the real Matthew Perry, generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life, and his struggles to become the man behind the icon.

metas.name: The Mob
metas.description: Celebrities compete in mob-themed challenges at an Italian villa for $250,000. They elect a don who controls eliminations and prize money. As power demands loyalty, contestants must decide whether to support the don or overthrow them.

metas.name: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?
metas.description: Once Japan's most renowned actor, Gen is suddenly forgotten. Fueled by a need for recognition, he claws his way back from zero in this comedy.

metas.name: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
metas.description: Thirty volunteers enter a real prison facility and are randomly assigned roles as guards or prisoners to test whether ordinary people conform to assigned power dynamics or maintain their empathy and individuality.

metas.name: Money Trap
metas.description: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.

metas.name: Friends Sex and Games
metas.description: A group of friends starts a daring game. Everyone throws their keys into a bowl—whoever picks one spends the night with the owner of that key.

metas.name: VisionQuest
metas.description: Vision is faced with many challenges while trying to regain his memory and humanity.

metas.name: Treasure Island
metas.description: Jim Hawkins discover a treasure map, but his mother Bess's actions put them both in danger. Aboard The Hispaniola, they navigate threats from pirate John Silver and Agent Aaron Graham as alliances shift and survival hangs in the b...

metas.name: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
metas.description: The re-opening of a mysterious 1985 cold case murder in Louisiana unearths a haunting history of bloodshed and long-buried trauma.

metas.name: Below
metas.description: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a remote town, a fisherman must fight to protect his family, his community, and his way of life.

Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.

metas.name: Inside the Circle

metas.name: Africa Earth's Wild Home

metas.description: One cold night, misfit Archie gets bitten by a zombie and after briefly considering ending his life, he decides he's going to figure out what the hell is happening to his body. So, with the help of his only friend and his lifelong crush, Archie sets out to find a cure before he turns into a full-blown monster and kills everyone.

metas.name: East of Eden
metas.description: In the farmlands of the Salinas Valley in California, successive generations of two families, the Trasks and the Hamiltons, are destined to reenact the fateful story of Cain and Abel.

metas.name: Outside
metas.description: Internet icons the Sidemen drop content creators into the great outdoors to battle through challenges, temptations and scheming for a share of £1 million.

metas.name: The Final Problem
metas.description: In 1959, 13 people are stranded on an islet near Mallorca during a storm. At their small hotel, English tourist Elisa Mander is found dead. When suicide seems unlikely, retired actor Basil, once Sherlock Holmes on screen, investig...

metas.name: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
metas.description: Following a mining accident in northern Chile, 33 miners are trapped deep underground. As the search for them begins, the men are fighting for their lives under extreme conditions.

metas.name: My Sad Dead
metas.description: A reclusive doctor with supernatural abilities faces a disruption when her young niece visits, bringing a different and more intense approach to their shared gift of communicating with spirits.

metas.name: Shaque: Trust No One
metas.description: A mother receives yearly photos of her missing child. After nine years of searching, she discovers the truth about the abduction lies not far away, but hidden among her closest circle.

metas.name: Delusion
metas.description: When her father's worsening dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder case, a small-town school teacher races to uncover the truth amid dark rumors.

metas.name: The Real Rooneys
metas.description: A candid glimpse into the Rooneys' world as soccer legend Wayne juggles dad duties and former England captain's wife Coleen balances motherhood with business ambitions.

metas.name: Minerva Academy
metas.description: At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

metas.name: The Fixers
metas.description: A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

metas.name: City of Blood
metas.description: Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.

metas.name: Physical Italia: da 100 a 1
metas.description: מאה ספורטאים איטלקים עומדים בפני אתגרים פיזיים מפרכים, וכל אחד מהם נאבק כדי לגבור על השאר ולזכות בתהילה ובתואר האלוף האמיתי היחיד.

metas.name: Stolen Heartbeats

metas.description: A double homicide in Kansas gains national attention, spanning over two decades with the involvement of two tenacious citizen sleuths.

metas.description: A pair of lookalikes, one a former French aristocrat and the other an alcoholic English lawyer, fall in love with the same woman amidst the turmoil of the French Revolution.

metas.description: Historians Dan Snow and Professor Suzannah Lipscomb investigate the lives and deaths of some of Tudor England's most fascinating figures, including Anne Boleyn, Mary, Queen of Scots, and Perkin Warbeck, who claimed to be one of the famed Princes in the Tower.

metas.name: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel

With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have

metas.name: Mousetrap
metas.description: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

metas.name: All the Truth in My Lies
metas.description: Coco and Marín travel in campers to celebrate Blanca's bachelorette party. What was supposed to be an adventure turns into a time bomb when a few secrets between them come to light.

metas.name: Death of the Pastor's Wife
metas.description: Follows Mica Miller's life and death. Wife of pastor John-Paul Miller. Features new footage, family interviews, allegations of control, circumstances of her mysterious death, ongoing search for answers.

metas.name: 9/11: Reunited
metas.description: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

metas.name: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
metas.description: They're building empires. They're building families. They're always unfiltered. metas.name: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies

metas.name: Take a Hike!

metas.name: Moria

metas.name: Umthetho

metas.name: Mourinho
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes look at José Mourinho's legendary career and ascent to becoming one of soccer's most celebrated and controversial coaches at the highest levels of the sport.

metas.name: Somebody Knows Something
metas.description: Follow true crime influencer Kara Chamberlain as she investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases that have stumped law enforcement and haunted internet sleuths for decades.

metas.name: Our Sticky Love
metas.description: A former boxing champion turned gang member seeks redemption as a small-town boxing coach, while becoming entangled with an amnesiac prosecutor and a complex web of lies surrounding their shared past.

metas.name: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
metas.description: Based on the events surrounding the 1988 Lockerbie bombing. Lockerbie will focus on the investigation into the crash on both sides of the Atlantic and the devastating effect it had on the small town and the families who lost loved...

metas.name: Final Project

metas.name: Wrath

metas.name: Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro
metas.description: Follows 12 up-and-coming dancers who move into one house and compete in a grueling audition process for a coveted pro dancer slot on Dancing with the Stars Season 35.

metas.name: Worst Neighbor Ever
metas.description: Think you know your neighbors? Think again. "Worst Neighbor Ever" features firsthand accounts of violence, intimidation, and harassment between neighbors.

metas.description: Manager Kim was an ordinary head of a household with a daughter and lived as a small citizen. In order to find his daughter, who is his everything, he reveals a secret that should never be revealed to the world.

metas.name: Notes from the Last Row
metas.description: A Korean lit professor and one-time novelist stopped writing after harsh criticism in his youth. Now teaching at a top university, he's frustrated with students' poor writing while living with his own failure.

metas.name: The Root of the Game

metas.description: A father imprisoned for his son's murder receives evidence suggesting his child may be alive, compelling him to escape and uncover the truth.

metas.name: Million Dollar Nannies
metas.description: A young group of elite nannies heads to Ibiza to launch a new kind of agency, built by nannies, for nannies. They're promised VIP families, life-changing money, and a shot at something bigger than any of them could build alone. But fierce competition, personal drama, and a scandal from the past threaten to derail the dream before the summer sets.

metas.name: The Evil Lawyer
metas.description: When a young attorney is accused of murdering a police officer's son, he teams up with the "Evil Lawyer" to exploit loopholes and prove his innocence.

metas.name: Norway: The Dark Horse
metas.description: After 26 years of tournament drought, Norway's 2026 World Cup hopes were next to nil. But what followed rekindled belief.

metas.name: Cape Fear
metas.description: A happily married couple faces a growing threat when a notorious killer from their past, Max Cady, is released from prison and seeks revenge.

metas.name: Michael Jackson: The Verdict

metas.name: James.
metas.description: James Rodríguez, Colombia's legendary No. 10, shares details of his journey to football's elite and the game's biggest stage.
